item.title: A Michigan dairy CAFO clash over manure digesters and clean water
item.description: A proposed dairy CAFO in mid-Michigan is fueling a heated fight over clean water, manure pollution and the future of industrial farming — as supporters tout jobs and renewable energy, and critics warn local rivers are already overwhelmed.

item.title: Opinion | EVs in 2026: A reset, not a retreat
item.description: Michigan knows how to design, build, test and improve vehicles better than anywhere in the world. Electric vehicles aren’t a rejection of that legacy. They’re its next evolution.

item.title: Whitmer signs classroom smartphone ban for Michigan schools. What to know
item.description: Michigan K-12 students will be banned from using smartphones during instructional time starting this fall. Here’s what to know about the new law signed Tuesday by Gov. Gretchen Whitmer.

item.title: Trump rethinking Canada bridge permit amid Michigan jeers, cheers
item.description: As President Donald Trump considers amending a key permit for the Gordie Howe International Bridge, some top Michigan Republicans back his threat to block the nearly completed span from opening, saying they think it will lead to ‘a good deal.’

item.title: Michigan agencies, outside groups question Consumers dam sale plan
item.description: In testimony to state regulators who will decide whether to approve the sale, experts questioned Consumers Energy’s financial math and raised concerns that new owners could stick the public with repair or removal costs.

item.title: Mike Duggan ‘studying’ Trump school choice program for Michigan
item.description: In his bid for Michigan governor, independent Mike Duggan is not ruling out a new federal ‘Education Freedom Tax Credit’ program that unions argue amounts to a ‘voucher scheme.’

item.title: Gretchen Whitmer: Raise $800M for Medicaid by taxing nicotine, gambling, ads
item.description: Gov. Gretchen Whitmer pitches $800M in new taxes as a way to ensure the ‘sustainability’ of Medicaid in Michigan. Republicans say no way.

item.title: Opinion | If Michigan wants to lead again, it must reinvest in education’s basics
item.description: In business, you don’t fix problems by cutting corners and hoping for the best. If we’re serious about making Michigan #1 in education, then we need to be honest about priorities.

item.title: Gretchen Whitmer pitches $88B budget. What it means for Michiganders, schools
item.description: Gov. Gretchen Whitmer’s office unveiled her $88B budget proposal on Wednesday, calling for more spending on literacy and education with some tax hikes and some tax breaks.

item.title: Mundy Township megasite won’t house data center; demolitions continue
item.description: Months after Sandisk withdrew plans for a semiconductor plant near Flint Bishop Airport, demolitions continue to assemble the megasite — even without a clear occupant.
